industry.biotechShare: Biotech companies' share of small-molecule approvals rose from 60% (2016) to 76% (2025); Big Pharma's fell from 40% to 24%

moat.evidence: 40 years of API chemistry; 300+ processes, 100+ APIs; deuterated molecules, chiral, cryogenic, peptides; supplies APIs to innovators for 4 approved NDAs and 27 INDs
Three USFDA-inspected plants; no Official Action Indicated, warning letter or import alert ever (CRISIL); Unit 1 closed with no observations (Mar-2024); 1,010+ filings, 75 active US DMFs
Exclusive supply written into innovators' filings; 'no one wants to disrupt supply chain' (CEO); but a handful of molecules and top-5 customers at 93% of CMS revenue
Mature, crowded molecules (Mirtazapine, Ezetimibe, Levetiracetam); Prime revenue fell 5% in FY26; management calls Prime low-margin
Three customer groups = 54% of FY26 revenue; top-5 products 65% of revenue (72% in Q1FY27)
15+ years of peptide process R&D; 6.37 kL plant commissioning from Sep-2026; first revenue expected in FY28; 8-10 programmes in development

critiques: Concentration: three customer groups were 54% of FY26 revenue (34% in FY25) and the CEO says 'about 3' commercial CMS molecules drive the business; the company does not name them.
Lumpiness: the quarterly EBITDA margin swung from 11.6% (Q1FY26) to 39.6% (Q4FY26); FY25 revenue fell 5%; management itself says Q4FY26 was 'a Q3 plus Q4' quarter.

Sponsor risk: the molecules brokers link to Neuland belong to BMS (xanomeline), Esperion/Daiichi Sankyo (bempedoic acid; Esperion received a takeover bid in May-2026) and Teva (deutetrabenazine); destocking, second-sourcing or patent expiry at any of them would hit profit hard.
The generic base is shrinking: Prime and Specialty APIs fell from Rs717 cr (FY24) to Rs688 cr (FY26); Specialty fell 16% in FY26 on Paliperidone delays.
Capex and returns: Rs1,460 cr approved in 13 quarters, 'much higher' capex ahead and possibly overseas M&A for new modalities; management expects ROCE to dip.

Governance: the three promoter directors were paid Rs42 cr in FY26 (8.6% of PBT); an investor alleged an edited call transcript (the company denies any change); no segment margins or molecule names are disclosed.
Valuation: Rs21,350 is ~55x trailing EPS (Rs388 for the twelve months to Jun-2026); the street pays for continued 20% growth from a peak-margin base.
gaps: Broker notes: only four notes found (Goldman via news summaries, Nuvama's Dec-2025 PDF, one unnamed EV/EBITDA note via a Business Standard headline, B&K's 2024 PDF) plus an S&P Global consensus snapshot; Business Standard refuses our tool (HTTP 403) and Trendlyne lists no recent notes; JM Financial and ICICI Securities cover the stock but their notes were not found. No consensus EPS standing on 30-Sep-2026 was available.
Segment margins (Prime, Specialty, CMS) are not disclosed; only management's qualitative ranking (Prime low, Specialty and CMS high).
Prime and Specialty rupee revenue are derived from disclosed percentage shares x revenue (CRISIL's FY26 growth rates match); Others is a residual.
CMS molecule and customer names are not disclosed; the molecules come from B&K (Oct-2024) and an analyst's question on the Q4FY26 call.
Tax on the FY25 exceptional gain is our estimate from the AR tax reconciliation (Rs7.2 cr); a Rs9.95 cr deferred-tax charge on 'capital items' in FY25 may also relate to the property.
India Ratings' Jul-2026 rationale could not be read (page renders only with JavaScript).
Utilisation by named unit and the total peptide programme cost (beyond the Rs254 cr reactor expansion) are not disclosed; FY20-21 segment mix not collected.
USFDA Unit 3 (Aug-2026): closure/EIR status at 30-Sep-2026 not confirmed in a primary filing.
conflicts: FY25 exceptional gain after tax: Screener Rs86 cr (FY25 EPS ex Rs135.6); Nuvama removes Rs76.4 cr (adjusted EPS Rs143.2); our AR-based estimate Rs69.2 cr (Rs148.8). We use Rs148.8; the reported-EPS and Screener versions are sensitivities.
EPS: company decks show standalone EPS (FY26 Rs283.0); Screener and the AR consolidated figure is Rs283.71. We use consolidated.
Exports: the company says ~90-92% of revenue is exported (by end market); the AR segment note puts customers located in India at 24% of FY26 revenue (Indian buyers that export).
Utilisation (CFO, May-2026): 'those 3 units are close to between 85% to 90% and the last unit is around 65%' - the split by unit is unclear.
Q1FY27 revenue: Rs641.5 cr (company) vs Rs642 cr (Screener, rounded).
